terminal_retention: Root durable historical failed outcomes and terminal cleanup summaries retained; no old raw journals or binary archive. Root owns terminal closure/deletion for every future fresh phase.
fresh_custody: All prior consumed preparation/freeze/campaign receipts, raw journals and runner-bin were terminally closed and removed by root. No old releases/manifests/outputs qualify.
